careers.title: Software Developer
careers.description: Designs, develops, and maintains software applications and systems.

education_requirements.notes: Strong portfolio can substitute for formal degree

careers.title: Data Analyst
careers.description: Analyzes data to generate insights that support business decisions.

education_requirements.notes: Strong analytical skills more important than specific degree

careers.title: Data Scientist
careers.description: Builds statistical models and machine learning systems to extract insights from data.

careers.title: AI/ML Engineer
careers.description: Builds, trains, and deploys machine learning models in production systems.

education_requirements.notes: Strong Python, mathematics, and systems skills required

careers.title: Cloud Engineer
careers.description: Designs, builds, and maintains cloud infrastructure and services.

careers.title: Cybersecurity Analyst
careers.description: Protects systems and networks from digital attacks and vulnerabilities.

careers.title: UI/UX Designer
careers.description: Designs user interfaces and experiences for digital products.

education_requirements.notes: Portfolio is the primary evaluation criterion

careers.title: Product Manager
careers.description: Defines and drives the development of products from conception to launch.

education_requirements.notes: Typically requires internship or APM program for entry level

careers.title: Business Analyst
careers.description: Bridges business needs and technical solutions by analyzing processes and requirements.

education_requirements.notes: Communication and analytical skills are critical

careers.title: DevOps Engineer
careers.description: Bridges development and operations to automate and streamline software delivery.

education_requirements.notes: Practical experience with Linux, CI/CD, and containers is essential

careers.title: Financial Analyst
careers.description: Analyzes financial data to support investment decisions and business planning.

careers.title: Digital Marketing Analyst
careers.description: Analyzes digital marketing campaigns and drives data-driven marketing decisions.

education_requirements.notes: Digital certifications (Google Analytics, Meta Blueprint) valued
